purpose: Prepared local-only import plan; not an upload script.
target_environment: Unverified. No Supabase endpoint was contacted and no records or files were uploaded.
source_validation: All staged PDFs match the source manifest SHA-256, are readable PDFs, and have 1–2 pages.
privacy_policy: All source documents show personal identifiers and contact/career details. Treat them as private and leave all preview and project approvals false until human privacy review and permission are confirmed.
workflow: Use the existing authenticated Admin Showcase UI and its RLS-protected project creation and upload paths; do not use a service-role key or direct database script.
Create each project as an unpublished sample_project in cv_demo; keep review, consent, and public-preview flags false.
Upload the original PDF through the existing Admin Showcase PDF upload path to private showcase-media storage.
Generate page previews only after the private renderer has been safely configured for the local test environment; keep generated previews unapproved.
After each confirmed action, update that item’s status, project/media IDs, storage path, timestamp, and any error in this manifest.
Before rerunning, check the exact slug and reconcile against this manifest; the unique slug constraint is the final duplicate-record guard.

renderer_readiness.renderer_dependencies: sharp, Playwright, ipaddr.js, and the Playwright Chromium executable are present locally
renderer_readiness.pdf_tools: pdfinfo and pdftoppm are available locally
renderer_readiness.reason: No local renderer URL/token configuration is present. The renderer entrypoint binds 0.0.0.0 by default, so it must not be launched as-is for a private local test. This execution environment cannot verify the host native stack.
